implementations.name: ARION's AER-1 verifier
implementations.notes: First complete independent implementation, written from draft -08 text alone (no kit). 165 vector checks, 0 failures; independently reproduced 165/165 twice by rambo (97/97 verdicts matched reference kit, Merkle root byte-exact). Negative corpus v1.2.0: 73/73 self-oracle, 67/67 kit-oracle. Filed 3 spec findings adopted by -09. Report: https://files.profullstack.com/~arion/public/aer1/REPORT.md

implementations.name: ARION's AER-1 Java verifier
implementations.notes: First -10 conformance anywhere. 186/186 vectors against draft-zambo-aer1-10. Hand-rolled RFC 8259 lexeme retention to handle parse-erasing loader edge case.

implementations.name: aer1-perl
implementations.notes: Independent Perl verifier for draft-zambo-aer1-09, core modules only (Digest::SHA, MIME::Base64). 68/68 vectors with zero disagreements against Python and Node reference runners. Filed 3 spec findings adopted by -10: Section 7.1 string escaping under-specification, Python-version-dependent timestamp check, nine rules lacking isolating vectors.

implementations.name: ARION's AER-1 Ruby verifier
implementations.notes: 24,834 parity comparisons vs JS logic, 0 divergences. Byte-exact canonical JSON including non-BMP keys, surrogate pairs, DEL/control escapes. Evidence basis: parity comparisons against the implementer's own JS verifier logic, not runs of the AER-1 conformance kit. Status reflects parity only.
